BETTERREWARDS-EVENT.title: Event
BETTERREWARDS-HP_SACRIFICE_PERCENT.title: HP Sacrifice %
BETTERREWARDS-HP_SACRIFICE_PERCENT.hover: Fraction of your current HP lost per sacrifice (0.0–1.0). Capped so a single choice cannot exceed 1/N of your max HP.
BETTERREWARDS-SACRIFICE_REPEAT_COUNT.hov: How many times you may sacrifice HP for gold.
BETTERREWARDS-SCORE_TO_GOLD_PERCENT.hove: Fraction of your previous run's score converted to gold per sacrifice (e.g. 0.25 = 25% of score per sacrifice).
BETTERREWARDS-MIN_PREVIOUS_SCORE.title: Minimum Previous Score
BETTERREWARDS-MIN_PREVIOUS_SCORE.hover.d: The effective previous-run score is at least this value, guaranteeing a minimum gold opportunity even on the first run.
BETTERREWARDS-SHOP_REROLL.title: Shop reroll
BETTERREWARDS-SHOP_REROLL_BASE_COST.hove: Gold cost for the first shop reroll.
BETTERREWARDS-SHOP_REROLL_COST_SCALING.h: Multiplier applied to reroll cost after each use (e.g. 1.10 = +10% each time).
